data.name: Sadasiva
data.gender_notes: Sadasiva is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sada means eternal and Siva means lord. It is the name of Lord Shiva, the supreme god in Hinduism. The name Sadasiva carries the meaning “Eternal Lord” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sadasiva usually hope their child will grow to embody eternal lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the eternal and unchanging nature of the divine. It represents the ultimate reality and the source of all existence.
data.etymology: Sadasiva belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Eternal Lord.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sadasiva total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Sadasiva" is deeply rooted in the rich culture and traditions of Hinduism. Lord Shiva, referred to as "Sadasiva," represents the eternal, unchanging, and infinite aspect of God. He is the deity of Rudra, the primal god of the rains and thunder, and his fetching beauty embodies the entirety of creation. The name "Sadasiva" is a powerful reminder of the eternal grace, power, and wisdom that Lord Shiva bestows upon his devotees.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, "Sadasiva" symbolizes the eternal, self-manifested presence of Lord Shiva. He is the embodiment of purity, compassion, and love, who transcends time and space. The name "Sadasiva" invokes the feeling of being in the constant presence of the divine, offering peace, strength, and protection to the devotee. Meditation and devotion to Lord Sadasiva help enkindle the spiritual flame within, inspiring the individual to strive for self-realization and union with the divine consciousness.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sadasiva is the embodiment of pure consciousness and eternal bliss. His name signifies the unchanging, self-existent, and ever-present aspect of Shiva, the supreme deity in Hinduism.

vedic_reference.note: Sadasiva is one of the many names of Lord Shiva in Hinduism. He is often depicted as the eternal form of Lord Shiva and is considered to be the embodiment of his infinite grace and benevolence.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Sadasiva is a form of Lord Shiva, mentioned in the Shiva Purana. The name Sadasiva carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Sadasiva continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Lakshmi Sadasiva in Hyderabad, India attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Sadasiva, which means "Eternal Lord". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.
